key_insight: SPPS extends Pauli-based simulation from forward evaluation to large-scale quantum optimization by using stochastic Pauli-path sampling to produce unbiased gradients.
engineering_relevance: This enables practical gradient-based tuning of quantum algorithms and parameter initialization for low-magic circuits at scales that are difficult for existing simulators.
method: Sample Pauli paths stochastically at each optimization step
Estimate gradients unbiasedly from the sampled paths
Use the resulting gradients in iterative optimization with convergence guarantees
evidence_signal: The abstract reports benchmarks on quantum eigensolver tasks up to 100 qubits and quantum neural networks up to 40 qubits, with optimization dynamics tracked faithfully and convergence achieved within minutes.
watch_item: Performance depends on sampling quality and the low-magic regime, so variance and runtime may grow for circuits outside the intended simulation setting.
paper_title: Stochastic Pauli-path simulator for large-scale quantum optimization
